name: dbx-mermaid
description: DBX plugin with a standalone Mermaid editor and live preview workbench.

scripts.verify:bundle: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const files=fs.readdirSync('ui/assets').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js'));if(files.length!==1){console.error('FAIL: ui/assets must contain exactly one JS bundle, found '+files.length+': '+files.join(', '));process.exit(1)}const src=fs.readFileSync(p.join('ui/assets',files[0]),'utf8');const bad=['import(','__vitePreload','__vite__mapDeps','</script'].filter(k=>src.includes(k));if(bad.length){console.error('FAIL: bundle contains dynamic-import or srcdoc-unsafe markers: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}console.log('OK: single self-contained bundle '+files[0]+' ('+(Buffer.byteLength(src)/1048576).toFixed(2)+' MiB), no dynamic imports')"
